title: Independent investigation of a heterostructured nanoscroll radius
difficulty_reasons: The agent must search a continuous positive inner-radius domain and establish coverage rather than stop at the first stationary point.
The piecewise complete/incomplete-turn geometry requires competing regime treatments and consistency checks.
The agent must formulate and discriminate at least two scientifically plausible model treatments, then independently validate convergence and local stability.

paper.title: Controlling Spontaneously-Formed Nanoscrolls by In-Plane Janus TMD/Traditional TMD Heterostructures

data.description: Closed JSON specification of the ordered two-segment ribbon and continuum material parameters.

required_deliverables.description: Independent radius investigation with candidate comparison, validation and limitations.
